CREATE TABLE crm.contacts (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES unified.contacts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    account_id uuid REFERENCES crm.accounts(id),
    entity_instance_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES crm.entity_instances(id),
    organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
    location_id uuid,
    is_primary boolean DEFAULT false,
    score numeric DEFAULT 0,
    lead_source text,
    source_lead_id uuid,
    source_customer_id uuid,
    linkedin_url text,
    tags text[],
    last_contacted_at timestamptz,
    last_engaged_at timestamptz,
    is_partner_delegate boolean DEFAULT false,
    created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
    created_by uuid,
    updated_by uuid,
    automation_bp_instance_id uuid,
    automation_esm_instance_id uuid,
    display_id text UNIQUE
);
